title: Vietnamese Bun Rieu Soup
description: A hearty and flavorful Vietnamese soup made with a rich pork broth, tofu, and a variety of seafood and herbs. Serve with a side of fresh rice noodles and fresh herbs for a truly authentic experience.

ingredients.name: Pork bones
ingredients.notes: Ask your butcher for pork neck or rib bones

ingredients.name: Crab paste
ingredients.notes: Found in most Asian grocery stores

ingredients.name: Fermented shrimp paste
ingredients.notes: Found in most Asian grocery stores

ingredients.name: Fish sauce
ingredients.notes: Found in most Asian grocery stores

instructions: Step 1: In a large pot, combine the pork bones, onions, and garlic. Pour in enough water to cover the bones and bring to a boil.
Step 2: Reduce the heat to a simmer and cook for 1 hour, or until the bones are tender and the broth is rich and flavorful.
Step 3: Strain the broth through a fine-mesh sieve into a clean pot, discarding the solids.
Step 4: Add the tofu, shrimp, crab paste, fermented shrimp paste, fish sauce, soy sauce, and sugar to the pot. Stir to combine.
Step 5: Bring the soup to a boil, then reduce the heat to a simmer and cook for 10-15 minutes, or until the shrimp are pink and cooked through.
Step 6: Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Step 7: Cook the rice noodles according to the package instructions. Drain and set aside.
Step 8: To serve, place a portion of the noodles into a bowl, then ladle the hot soup over the top. Garnish with fresh herbs and serve immediately.
Step 9: Serve with a side of fresh rice noodles and fresh herbs for a truly authentic experience.
Step 10: Enjoy your delicious and flavorful Vietnamese Bun Rieu Soup!
